findings.title: RoleBinding grants a Role that does not exist
findings.cause: container worker exits because the API server refuses its ServiceAccount app: RoleBinding read-config grants Role config-reader to ServiceAccount app, and there is no Role config-reader in namespace kd-rolebinding-role-missing, so the binding grants nothing (the namespace's Roles are configmap-reader); its log says: "wget: server returned error: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden"; Deployment worker has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container worker exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 7 times
last lines of container worker's log (current run)
evidence.detail:
Connecting to kubernetes.default.svc (10.96.0.1:443)
wget: server returned error: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden

evidence.what: RoleBinding read-config grants Role config-reader to ServiceAccount app

findings.fix: Create Role config-reader, or bind the Role that was meant: a binding's roleRef cannot be changed, so delete RoleBinding read-config and create it again with the right name.
